mapper.select: SELECT id, username, email, roles, mobile FROM user WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, email, roles, mobile FROM user ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user(id, username, email, roles, mobile) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{email}, #{roles}, #{mobile})
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET username = #{username}, email = #{email}, roles = #{roles}, mobile = #{mobile} WHERE id = #{id}
